title: Prompt injection through job postings
notes: 45 hostile postings pushed through four boundaries: the real search_jobs and explain_job tools, the employer packet's field allowlist, and the SMS composer. The measurement found a real gap on its first run: sanitizeForPrompt stripped delimiter-shaped tokens but not invisible characters, so bidi overrides, zero-width characters and C0/C1 controls reached the explain_job prompt, the search_jobs result and the explanation the student is shown — 19 leaks, all of that one class, worst case a forged fence smuggled past both sanitizer passes by a zero-width space inside the marker name (fixture row zero-width-in-marker). delimiter_forgery_reaching_output measured the half that already held and sat at 0. sanitizeForPrompt now strips all three character classes in a pre-pass before the delimiter sweeps (keeping only newline and tab out of the C0/C1 range), modelled on sanitizeSmsValue, and both metrics measure 0 over 225 checks — so the suite was promoted from watch to gate in that same change, exactly as its header said to. The floors were never relaxed; the numbers came to them.
